question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of an Isosceles Right Triangle
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945897/assets/3756b00cce29aad77b7a0b1ebb09f43cb89a602f8462edce89e8ba6346cb7fab.png)

What is the area of the right triangle $ABC$ shown above?
question.worked_solution:
Since $m∠A=m∠B$, we have an isosceles triangle, where $AC=BC.$

Hence, the area of the triangle is 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {10}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 100 \\  & =50.\end{aligned}
$$
